hooks.command: EVAL_FILE=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path' <<< "$HOOK_INPUT") && if [[ -f "$EVAL_FILE" ]]; then TARGET=$(cat "$EVAL_FILE" | head -1 | tr -d '\n') && echo "📝 Evaluating: $TARGET" && if [[ -f "$TARGET" ]]; then if [[ "$TARGET" == *"requirements.md" ]]; then python3 .claude/skills/requirements-gathering/eval-requirements.py "$TARGET" 2>&1; elif [[ "$TARGET" == *"prd.md" ]]; then python3 .claude/skills/prd-creation/eval-prd.py "$TARGET" 2>&1; elif [[ "$TARGET" == *"test-plan.md" ]]; then python3 .claude/skills/test-plan/eval-test-plan.py "$TARGET" 2>&1; elif [[ "$TARGET" == *"user-stories.md" ]]; then python3 .claude/skills/user-story-expansion/eval-user-stories.py "$TARGET" 2>&1; else echo "⚠️  Unknown file type: $TARGET (expecting requirements.md, prd.md, test-plan.md, or user-stories.md)"; fi; else echo "❌ File not found: $TARGET"; fi; fi
